item.title: Titan Machinery FY27 Q2 net loss widens to $9.2 million; revenue drops 9.2% to $496.38 million
item.description: Titan Machinery posted a Q2 fiscal 2027 net loss of USD 9.2 million, widening from a net loss of USD 6 million. Revenue fell 9.2% to USD 496.38 million, led
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Titan Machinery posted a Q2 fiscal 2027 net loss of USD 9.2 million, widening from a net loss of USD 6 million. Revenue fell 9.2% to USD 496.38 million, led by softer equipment demand amid sustained lower agricultural commodity prices. Gross margin rose 1.5 percentage points to 18.6% on higher equipment margin, helped by a richer parts-and-service mix. Floorplan interest expense dropped 46.2% to USD 3.66 million due to lower interest-bearing inventory levels. Europe swung to a segment loss before income taxes of USD 1.33 million, while Agriculture loss narrowed to USD 3.29 million. item.title: Cuentas FY26 Q2 net loss widens to $888,000; operating expenses more than doubled to $803,000
item.description: Cuentas posted a GAAP net loss of USD 888,000 for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, swinging from net income of USD 378,000. Operating expenses more than dou
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Cuentas posted a GAAP net loss of USD 888,000 for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, swinging from net income of USD 378,000. Operating expenses more than doubled to USD 803,000, led by officers’ compensation of USD 657,000 and professional services of USD 104,000. Other expenses were USD 21,000, reflecting interest expense of USD 3,000 and an USD 18,000 derivative warrants fair-value loss. For the six months, net loss widened to USD 1.39 million from USD 21,000; operating expenses climbed 88.39% to USD 1.14 million. Liquidity remained strained with USD 800 cash, a USD 4.3 million working-capital deficit, and an accumulated deficit of about USD 61.21 million.
